test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Occurring after the death of the said person
solution:
The correct answer is **Posthumous.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is Posthumous.
 
• Posthumous means** occurring, being given, or existing after the creator's passing.**
 
• Thus the correct answer is Posthumous.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Effusive -** Effusive** means **displaying or expressing uninhibited or sincere appreciation, joy, or approbation.**
 
• Gregarious - **Gregarious** means (**of a person) gregarious and likes company.**
 
• Fugitive - **Fugitive** means **a person who is in hiding or has fled from captivity.**
